# The supported practice review card

The new card asks which task felt uncertain and who could help on the next shift. It produces shorter, more useful answers than asking whether the volunteer feels confident overall. Supported practice is still the same induction responsibility with a different method. [[Volunteer handbook]] should not imply we stopped caring about safety because the vocabulary became friendlier.
